Similarly, Humana rejects, denies or recoups reimbursements for submissions that are not submitted as replacement claims, according to the guidance outlined in this policy, that Humana determines should have been submitted as replacement claims because they overlap previous claims. Any discrepancy between the data on a claim submitted previously and the data on a related replacement claim could prompt Humana to request additional information to substantiate the accuracy and completeness of the replacement claim. reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. To make a correction to data that was in any type of previous provider submission, whether a reimbursable claim or a non- reimbursable encounter for which information is gathered for reporting, including a correction that adds entirely new data, such as late charges, Humana requires a provider to:

Submit a complete replacement of the claim submitted previously.

In that replacement claim, report a claim frequency code of 7 to indicate that it is a replacement claim, as follows:

In loop 2300 CLM05-3 of an 837 electronic transaction;

In the resubmission code field in box 22 of a CMS-1500 paper claim form; or

As the final digit of the type of bill (TOB) code in box 4 of a UB-04, also known as a CMS-1450, paper claim form.

In that replacement claim, report the claim number that Humana assigned to the claim that is being replaced, as follows:

In segment REF02 of loop 2300, using qualifier F8 in segment REF 01, of the 837 electronic transaction;

In the original ref. no. field in box 22 of the CMS-1500 paper claim form; or

As the document control number in box 64 of the UB-04, or the CMS-1450, paper claim form. Humana rejects, denies or recoups reimbursement for submissions for replacement claims when submitted outside the guidelines above. Similarly, Humana rejects, denies or recoups reimbursements for submissions that are not submitted as replacement claims, according to the guidance outlined in this policy, that Humana determines should have been submitted as replacement claims because they overlap previous claims. Any discrepancy between the data on a claim submitted previously and the data on a related replacement claim could prompt Humana to request additional information to substantiate the accuracy and completeness of the replacement claim. If Humana determines that the replacement claim is inaccurate or incomplete, it is subject to rejection, denial or recoupment. Note: For Humana Medicaid plans, this policy applies except when not permitted by state Medicaid guidelines.
